capabilities: : Subdivide selected text into a new file
extras: The plugin requires a well-structured file (ideally maintained by a linter) and handles special characters by replacing them with underscores.
intentEvidence: Subdivider is an efficient plugin for Obsidian that simplifies note organization.
motivation: The author prefers shorter notes and built the plugin to break down large, monolithic notes into smaller, manageable pieces.
problem: Managing large and complex notes within a single file can be difficult and cumbersome.
summary: Subdivider converts notes into nested folders and automatically creates separate files based on subheadings within a document.
